postCreateCommand:
sudo npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && [ -f "$HOME/google-cloud-sdk/path.bash.inc" ] && (grep -qF 'google-cloud-sdk/path.bash.inc' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo '

[ -f "$HOME/google-cloud-sdk/path.bash.inc" ] && source "$HOME/google-cloud-sdk/path.bash.inc"
